latest_final: A prisoner arranged with a prison guard to escape by hiding in a coffin during a funeral. The plan was for the coffin to be buried outside the prison, after which the guard—who was supposed to be alive and waiting outside—would open it. The guard died after making the arrangement but before the prisoner entered the coffin. Unaware of this, the prisoner hid beside the guard’s body and was buried. When he struck a match and recognized the guard, he realized the rescue would never come. He could not open the coffin or summon help, and died trapped underground. The match revealed that the plan had failed; it did not trigger the danger. The answers do not establish his exact physical cause of death.
